newsitem.title: USA: Digitran says suit led to Chapter 11 filing.
newsitem.headline: Digitran says suit led to Chapter 11 filing.

text.p: Digitran Systems Inc, which filed for chapter 11 protection Friday in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware, told Reuters it had done so to protect shareholders, creditors and employees from a "perceived...rush to judgment" in a class action shareholder suit pending against the company.

Digitran, of Logan, Utah, makes training simulators for the petroleum industry. The shareholder lawsuit is related to the March delisting of Digitran from the American Stock Exchange, court papers say.

"Digitran anticipates that it will continue operations in meeting its corporate obligations despite this (bankruptcy) filing, including its commitments to customers responsible for the significant increased sales volume since...April 30, 1996", the company said.
